source_locator: R416: p. 237; R273: table of 1944, September row
current_activity: The 11th Panzer Division leaves the Belfort Gap to reinforce the Fifth Panzer Army
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 5 p. 237: "After the retreat from southern France the division took up position in the Belfort Gap, from which it moved on 18 September to reinforce the Fifth Panzer Army"; Lexikon der Wehrmacht, 11. Panzer-Division, table 1944: September, LXXXV Corps, 19. Armee, Heeresgruppe G, "Belfort". Event definition: the departure of 18 September. Event support: CMH and the Lexikon table (two families). Location: Belfort with a precision of 10 km, the place of the position it left. Location approximate: a town point for the Belfort Gap. Location support: CMH and the Lexikon name Belfort. Commander: Generalleutnant Wend von Wietersheim.

current_activity: The 11th Panzer Division attacks at 0900 and takes Marsal, then reaches Vic-sur-Seille
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 5 p. 237-238: "The main attack by the 11th Panzer Division jumped off the next morning at 0900" and "the Germans seized Marsal". Event definition: the attack of 25 September, the day after the scouts reported Moyenvic unoccupied. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Marsal with a precision of 5 km. Location approximate: the point of the attack; the division command post is not named. Location support: CMH names the town. Commander: Generalleutnant Wend von Wietersheim. Opponents: US 4th Armored Division (25th Cavalry Squadron).
